Job description:

Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is hiring a Full-time System Analyst role in Collie, Western Australia. Apply now to become part of our team.

Requirements for this role

Flexible hours available
Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
Relevant work rights for Australia
Work location: In person
Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is looking for an experienced System Analyst to support the company’s ICT systems and business operations at our Collie, Western Australia location.

On a full-time basis, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team, consulting with business users and technical stakeholders to evaluate existing ICT systems, identify operational requirements, and recommend practical system improvements.

Position Title: System Analyst
ANZSCO Occupation: Systems Analyst – ANZSCO 261112
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: AU$90,000.00 to AU$98,000.00 per year plus superannuation
Work Location: In person

About the Role

The System Analyst will evaluate the processes, procedures, and methods used in the company’s existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems to meet operational and user requirements.

The successful applicant will work closely with management, business users, developers, vendors, and ICT support personnel to gather requirements, prepare system specifications, coordinate system testing, and support the implementation of reliable and effective technology solutions.

Requirements

Applicants should demonstrate the following:

Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a System Analyst, Systems Analyst, ICT Business Analyst, or in a closely related ICT systems role
Relevant qualification in Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or an equivalent field
Strong understanding of ICT systems, business processes, system workflows, and operational requirements
Experience consulting with users to gather, analyse, formulate, and document business and system requirements
Experience evaluating existing systems, business processes, procedures, and work practices
Ability to identify system limitations, operational inefficiencies, integration issues, and areas for improvement
Experience preparing functional specifications, system requirement documents, workflow diagrams, process models, data models, and technical documentation
Experience supporting system implementation, integration, configuration, testing, and deployment activities
Understanding of system testing, user acceptance testing, defect tracking, quality assurance, and change management processes
Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, enterprise resource planning systems, customer relationship management systems, or similar business platforms
Ability to prepare user guides, training materials, system procedures, technical reports, and operational documentation
Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical users
Good analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and project coordination skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to system quality, data integrity, and continuous improvement
Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team
Responsibilities

The System Analyst’s responsibilities will include:

Consult with users, managers, clients, and technical stakeholders to understand operational needs and formulate clear business and system requirements.
Analyse existing ICT systems, business processes, procedures, workflows, and work practices to identify limitations, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate the processes and methods used in existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems.
Translate user and business requirements into clear functional specifications and system documentation for developers, vendors, and ICT support teams.
Use data modelling, process modelling, workflow mapping, and other analysis techniques to prepare clear system specifications.
Develop business requirement documents, functional requirement specifications, system process diagrams, data flow diagrams, process notes, and implementation documentation.
Review proposed system solutions to ensure they meet business requirements, operational objectives, technical standards, and user expectations.
Work closely with developers, ICT support teams, external vendors, and business users throughout system design, configuration, implementation, and support activities.
Assist with the preparation, adoption, and implementation of system test plans to ensure acceptable system quality, functionality, reliability, and data integrity.
Coordinate and support system testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, issue identification, defect tracking, and resolution.
Monitor system implementation activities and confirm that approved requirements and functional specifications have been correctly delivered.
Assess system functionality and user feedback and recommend improvements to system usability, performance, workflows, and business processes.
Review and improve user access procedures, account management processes, permission controls, shared data structures, and business application workflows.
Support the deployment of functional ICT solutions and assist users during system transitions, upgrades, and process changes.
Prepare user guides, system procedures, operating instructions, training materials, and technical support documentation.
Deliver system training and provide practical guidance to staff and other business users.
Act as a central source of information and provide advice and assistance during system-related planning and decision-making.
Maintain accurate system records, configuration information, issue registers, testing records, and operational reports.
Monitor system performance, service requests, recurring user issues, and operational incidents to support reliable day-to-day business operations.
Assist with system-related onboarding and offboarding processes, including user account access, permissions, application access, and system usage guidance.
Maintain clear communication with stakeholders and provide practical technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, system functionality, and user experience.
Perform other related system analysis and ICT project duties as reasonably required.
Application

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and submit an up-to-date CV.

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted to arrange a suitable time to discuss the position, their experience, and their suitability for the role.

Work Location: In person

?? Looking for More Than Just a Job?
Ready for a fresh start?

Want to step away from the pressure of construction sites and into a role where your skills are valued, your work is varied, and your career can genuinely progress?

Are you:
Tired of competing with multiple trades just to get your work done?
Looking for more service and maintenance work rather than repetitive construction?
Interested in expanding your knowledge across both wet fire and dry fire systems?
We’re looking for an experienced Sprinkler Service Technician to join our growing statewide team.
This is more than just a sprinkler role—it’s an opportunity to build a long-term career with one of Tasmania’s leading compliance companies.

?? Why Join us?
We live by six core values:

Freedom
We trust our people and provide the flexibility to succeed.

United
We support one another and celebrate success as one team.

Technology
We invest in industry-leading systems, equipment and innovation.

Unstoppable
We take ownership, solve problems and deliver results.

Remarkable
We strive to exceed expectations for our clients and each other.

Environment
We care about our people, our communities and the environments we work in.

?? What’s In It For You?
4-Day Work Week (Monday–Thursday)
Fridays PAID OFF — every week
Attractive salary package (negotiable based on experience)
Maintained company vehicle
Diverse service and maintenance work
Exposure to both wet and dry fire systems
Career progression opportunities
Ongoing technical training and professional development
Modern systems, technology and equipment
High-performing, supportive team culture

??? The Role
As a Sprinkler Service Technician, you will:
Service, inspect and maintain commercial sprinkler systems
Diagnose faults and complete repairs
Carry out routine maintenance in accordance with Australian Standards
Assist with sprinkler system upgrades and minor installations
Complete digital service reports and documentation
Represent us professionally on client sites
Work closely with our fire detection and compliance teams
Assist in delivering complete compliance solutions to our clients

This role combines:
Preventative maintenance
Fault finding and repairs
Client interaction
Compliance reporting
Opportunities to develop skills across other fire protection disciplines
No two days are the same.

?? About Us
We are a specialist commercial building compliance company delivering integrated:
Fire Protection Services
Sprinkler Systems
Fire Detection Systems
Fire Equipment Servicing
Emergency Lighting
Electrical Compliance
Thermal Imaging
RCD Testing
First Aid & Defibrillator Services
Workplace Safety & Compliance Solutions
We exist to remove compliance risk from commercial environments by delivering planned, documented and audit-ready compliance systems under one accountable provider.

With offices and warehouses located in:
Hobart
Launceston
Devonport

We continues to grow across Tasmania, providing exciting opportunities for motivated people who want to grow with us.

?? What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who brings:
Strong work ethic and reliability
Professional presentation
Excellent communication skills
Pride in delivering quality workmanship
A positive, team-first attitude
Accountability and initiative
A willingness to continue learning and developing
We value attitude just as much as technical ability.

?? Minimum Requirements
The successful applicant must hold, or be willing to obtain prior to commencement:
Current Sprinkler Fitter Licence/Ticket
Current White Card
Current Driver’s Licence
National Police Check
Working with Vulnerable People Registration

?? Why This Role Stands Out
This is a genuine opportunity to build a rewarding career—not just another service role.

You’ll enjoy:
Better work-life balance with a 4-day working week
Exposure to a broad range of fire protection systems
Opportunities to expand into dry fire and broader compliance services
Long-term career progression within a growing Tasmanian business
If you bring the right attitude, technical ability and commitment, we’ll provide the support, training and opportunities to help you achieve your career goals.

Apply Now
If you’re ready to join a company that values its people, invests in their development and is committed to delivering industry-leading compliance solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Join us and help protect Tasmania’s people, property and businesses.

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a service technician?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Do you have a current Police Check (National Police Certificate) for employment?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Are you licenced to drive a manual vehicle?

result.description:
Full-time Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in NSW.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Fire Protection Equipment Technician
•	Salary Range: $90,000 - $105,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Essential Passive Fire Protection Services Pty Ltd is a proudly Australian-owned and operated company dedicated to delivering premier facility maintenance and safety solutions. We specialise in comprehensive fire protection services, ensuring that commercial, industrial, and residential properties remain safe, compliant, and fully operational. Our commitment to excellence, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety forms the foundation of our operations, enabling us to provide unparalleled service to our diverse client base.

About the role
The Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician is responsible for ensuring that all passive fire containment systems are correctly installed, inspected, tested, and maintained in strict compliance with the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and applicable Australian Standards, primarily AS 1851. The role involves working with a variety of passive fire systems, including but not limited to fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Install, repair, and maintain passive fire containment systems, including fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire/smoke doors, and shutters.
•	Ensure all installations and maintenance works are executed in accordance with manufacturer specifications, the BCA, and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Select and apply appropriate fire-stopping materials for various penetrations and construction joints.
•	Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance testing of passive fire protection systems in accordance with AS 1851.
•	Assess the integrity of fire compartments, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.
•	Identify, diagnose, and report on defects, non-conformances, or compromised fire separations.
•	Perform necessary rectification and repair works on non-compliant passive fire systems to restore full regulatory compliance.
•	Provide technical recommendations for the upgrade or replacement of obsolete or irreparably damaged passive fire infrastructure.
•	Accurately complete and submit service reports, logbooks, defect notices, and compliance certificates in a timely manner.
•	Maintain comprehensive digital and physical records of all inspections, tests, and rectification works using the company’s designated field service management software.
•	Capture and upload clear photographic evidence of pre- and post-rectification works.
•	Ensure the correct use, maintenance, and storage of all Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), tools, and company vehicles.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive understanding of the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and AS 1851 as they relate to passive fire protection.
•	Ability to read, interpret, and work from architectural drawings, engineering plans, and fire matrix schedules.
•	High level of attention to detail and precision in workmanship.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex compliance issues on-site.
•	Proficiency in using mobile technology (tablets/smartphones) and field service management software for reporting and documentation.
•	Excellent time management skills with the capacity to work autonomously and manage a daily schedule of site visits.
•	Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Certificate III level or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position
•	White card

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $90,000-$105,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

Type: Full-time

About the Business:
Image Embroidery is a well-established embroidery and promotional products specialist based in Canning Vale, Perth, Western Australia. The company specialises in high-quality custom logo embroidery, digitising, and the production of corporate, sports, casual apparel, headwear, and promotional items. Known for its commitment to excellence, quick turnaround, and outstanding customer service, Image Embroidery operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that values creativity, attention to detail, innovation, and teamwork. The business prides itself on delivering cost-effective, high-quality solutions and building strong client relationships through professional and reliable service.
About the Position:
Image Embroidery is seeking a highly motivated Industrial Designer with a strong embroidery design focus to join our team in Canning Vale. The role involves creating and developing custom designs for embroidery and promotional products, managing design processes from concept to production, and working closely with clients, sales, and production teams to deliver high-quality outcomes within tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. This position plays a key role in driving innovation and ensuring design excellence that supports the company’s reputation for superior promotional products.
Key Responsibilities:
Concept visualisation and sketching according to client requirements.
Consult effectively with the sales team and clients about design requirements, product designs, and resolve design concerns to meet agreed outcomes.
Investigate appropriate materials and develop production processes to ensure ability to produce cost-effective products and meet client requirements.
Ensure that timelines are aligned with production schedules and implement cost optimisation initiatives.
Ensure concepts are closely aligned to requirements through the production of detailed plot charts, blue-prints, renderings, and sample designs.
Produce technical drawings and accurately test product designs using models, prototypes, specialist computer software, and computer-aided design (CAD) technology.
Collaborate closely with the production team to resolve any product faults or manufacturing concerns relating to the design, production time, or materials issues.
Collaborate with the sales team, as required, to present designs, samples, and final work to customers for review and evaluation.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Appropriate Industrial Design / Product Design and Development qualifications.
Minimum 10 years’ relevant experience.
Advanced proficiency in CAD software, design rendering tools, and digitising software specific to embroidery and textile applications.

For over 45+ years, Walz have been providing specialist maintenance and construction solutions for the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. We take a multi-disciplinary approach to deliver safe, reliable, cost-effective solutions.

The heart of our service delivery is our team of highly skilled, long-term employees who possess a breadth and depth of experience that enables us to support a diverse range of projects. We have offices in Brisbane, Gladstone, and Mackay.

We are seeking qualified Welders to join our team of dedicated professionals. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

The Welder is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, and repair of metal structures and components in accordance with engineering drawings and specifications. The role also includes a strong focus on maintaining safe work practices and adhering to environmental management standards, whilst maintaining Walz Group goals and objectives.

Technical Duties
Interpret and work from blueprints, technical drawings, and job specifications to determine project requirements.
Select, clean, and prepare metal stock for fabrication tasks.
Mark, cut, and shape metal components using hand tools, flame-cutting torches, and machine tool.
Bend and form metal parts using mechanical tools and heating/hammering methods.
Align and assemble components using measuring instruments and hand tools.
Join metal parts using welding, bolting, and riveting techniques.
Inspect completed welds for bead width, penetration, and conformance to quality standards.
Finish, clean, and polish fabricated components as required.

Safety Management Duties
Follow and promote compliance with all occupational health and safety (OHS) policies and procedures.
Conduct risk assessments and participate in toolbox talks and safety briefings.
Identify and report hazards, near-misses, and incidents promptly.
Ensure all tools and equipment are used correctly and maintained in safe working order.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
Participate in safety audits and assist in implementing corrective actions.

Environmental Management
Comply with environmental regulations and company policies to minimize environmental impact.
Ensure proper disposal of waste materials, including metal scraps and hazardous substances.
Use environmentally friendly practices where possible in fabrication and finishing processes.
Report environmental hazards and assist in managing spills or contamination incidents.
Contribute to the company's sustainability goals by supporting efficient use of materials and energy.

Skills and Qualifications
Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (or equivalent).
Proficiency in welding (MIG, TIG, Stick), cutting, and metal forming techniques.
Sound knowledge of workplace health, safety, and environmental (HSE) requirements.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and plans.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment

Physical Requirements
Ability to work in physically demanding environments including heights, confined spaces, and hot/cold conditions.
Capability to lift heavy materials and operate heavy machinery and tools.
Endurance to stand, bend, and work for extended periods.

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: 38 hours $44.63/hr + Super. Guaranteed overtime paid in accordance with the applicable legislative instrument in place.
